name: Announcement
description: A dismissible pill or full-width strip for product news, with a label, a short message and a link.

props.name: children
props.description: The message. Keep it to one short line.

props.name: variant
props.description: A small centred pill that a band of light crosses once on mount, or a full-width strip in water tint.

props.name: label
props.description: The badge before the message. Pass null for none.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the link goes. Without it there is no link.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called once the close animation has finished. If focus was inside the announcement, it has already moved to the next focusable element after it (or the one before it, or failing both its container).

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Remembers the dismissal in localStorage under this key, so the announcement stays hidden on later visits. Read after hydration.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the close button.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer element, which closes its height when dismissed. Also accepts every other div prop.
